title: Strict augmented families and their normalized derived comparisons
statement: For an abelian category $\mathcal A$ with finite coproducts and a parameter category $P$, define $Q_{\ge0}$ as extension of nonnegative complexes by zero followed by derived localization, and $T$ as the signed alternating-coface total followed by the same extension [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories] [def-sp-double-complex-total]. An augmented model is a functor $X:P\to\operatorname{Ch}^{\ge0}(\mathcal A)$, a functor $K:P\to\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta,\operatorname{Ch}^{\ge0}(\mathcal A))$, a strict augmentation $\operatorname{const}(X)\to K$, and a natural total augmentation $X\to T(K)$ which is a quasi-isomorphism at every parameter. In degree $q\ge0$ its component is the augmentation into Cech degree zero followed by the $(0,q)$ diagonal inclusion. For a specified exact transformation $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to H$, define its descended unit by localization, including the identity-functor comparison. For a commutative ringed site, define its module category and canonical derived Cech columns, operators, coefficient/refinement transitions and augmentation using the existing coherent image model [def-sfb-coherent-cech-image-model] [def-sfb-element-site-localization] [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]; exact slice restriction is the derived overFunctor [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact] [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. A pushforward family consists of an augmented model for these columns, a natural point isomorphism and column isomorphisms respecting every operator, transition and augmentation. For arbitrary $M:P\to D(\mathcal A)$, an augmented model $b$ and a natural isomorphism $a:M\cong Q_{\ge0}b.\mathrm{point}$, an additive left-exact $G:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$, exact additive $T:\mathcal B\to\mathcal C$ and $H:\mathcal A\to\mathcal A$, and a specified $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to H$, a unit family consists of source and target augmented models in $\mathcal C$, natural point identifications with $T_D RG(M)$ and $T_D RG(H_D M)$, and column identifications with $T_D RG(Q_{\ge0}b_n)$ and $T_D RG(H_D Q_{\ge0}b_n)$. These respect all parameter arrows and cosimplicial operators and carry the augmentations to $T_D RG(a\,Q_{\ge0}b_{\mathrm{aug}})$ and its $H_D$ image. A strict map between the two column families represents $T_D RG(\eta_D)$ on each column. Natural total comparisons are normalized by the total augmentations and satisfy the square for the actual $T_D RG(\eta_{D,M})$. The ringed-site comparison uses the same data with the canonical Cech columns. No existence of these records is included in this definition.
